# LibreRun LangGraph adapter — resolved dependency lock. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
#
# Why this is a SECOND lock rather than rows in backend/requirements.lock.txt:
# the image installs the adapter, but `chassis-zero-agents` deliberately runs
# with LangGraph absent — test_adapter_kit.py exists to prove the battery
# degrades correctly without it. Folding langgraph into the chassis lock would
# install it everywhere that lock is used and quietly destroy that premise.
#
# Resolved under --constraint ../requirements.lock.txt, so every package the
# two locks share is pinned to the same version and installing both is
# consistent. The adapter itself is not in here; the image installs it from
# the local path with --no-deps, so this file is the whole of its dependency
# closure.
#
# Regenerate with scripts/lock_requirements.sh, which rebuilds both locks in
# the right order.
